**q25.** Engine: CEL (Google `cel-go`) filter engine in `internal/filter` (entry `filter.DefaultEngine()`, `internal/filter/engine.go`; schema `internal/filter/schema.go`, parser `internal/filter/parser.go`, renderer `internal/filter/render.go`). Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled and normalized into a dialect-agnostic IR condition tree, then the renderer emits a dialect-specific SQL fragment plus bound args (`DialectSQLite`/`DialectMySQL`/`DialectPostgres`), which each driver appends to its WHERE clause via `filter.AppendConditions` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69`.

**q26.** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (the memo row plus all comment memo rows deleted by the handler). `memo_share` rows are removed only by the schema-level `FOREIGN KEY (memo_id) REFERENCES memo(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:102-110`), and SQLite opens with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`), so that cascade does not fire on SQLite. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but never deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545-563`).

**q27.** Mechanism: the built SPA in `server/router/frontend/dist` is compiled into the binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served as Echo static files with an SPA fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21,40-60`, invoked from `server/server.go:70` (`frontend.NewFrontendService(...).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`). The frontend build is placed there by `cd web && pnpm release` (AGENTS.md).

**q28.**
- s3presign runner — `RunOnce` once at startup, then a 12-hour `time.NewTicker` loop (`server/server.go:158-166`; `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-40`)
- Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (cron scheduler, `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `doc.go`) is never wired into the server — referenced only by its own tests/examples (`internal/scheduler/integration_test.go`, `example_test.go`). Also `server/runner/memopayload`'s `Runner`/`RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) is never started; only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:150-173` (installed on the Connect transport at `:177-181`; proactive/dedup refresh via `refreshAccessToken`, `:87`). Tokens: short-lived JWT access token sent as `Authorization: Bearer` (held in `web/src/auth-state.ts`) and a long-lived refresh token in the `memos_refresh` HTTP-only cookie (sent via `credentials: "include"`, refreshed by `AuthService.RefreshToken`); the backend also accepts personal access tokens (`memos_pat_` prefix). Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`server/auth/token.go`, `server/auth/authenticator.go`), used through `Authorizer` in `server/router/api/v1/authz.go:34-36`.

**q30.**
- memo created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (called `memo_service.go:157`), activity `memos.memo.created`
- memo updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` — `memo_service_webhooks.go:20` (called `memo_update_helpers.go:67`), activity `memos.memo.updated`
- memo deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` — `memo_service_webhooks.go:25` (called `memo_service.go:562`), activity `memos.memo.deleted`
- comment created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` — `memo_service_webhooks.go:30` (called `memo_service_comments.go:119`), activity `memos.memo.comment.created`

The first three converge on `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, `:120`).
